FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
ElectroSupply Solutions specializes in the wholesale distribution of UL-listed electrical components and consumer-grade electrical supplies. We operate without providing on-site installation services, which significantly reduces our liability exposure. Our inventory includes low-voltage wiring and cabling designed for both residential and commercial applications, supported by rigorous quality control processes. We emphasize compliance with the National Electrical Code (NEC) and all relevant local regulations to ensure safety and minimize product liability risks. Our team is dedicated to maintaining robust inventory management systems, and we have implemented documented cybersecurity protocols to safeguard customer and payment data.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in the manufacturing or distribution of high-voltage power generation or transmission equipment, nor does it participate in the design, engineering, or installation of electrical systems in hazardous or industrial environments. We confirm full compliance with NEC, UL, and all applicable local codes. Additionally, we acknowledge the requirement for product recall coverage for our branded lighting products, which we have implemented accordingly. We have no unresolved regulatory violations or product recalls in the past five years.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: ElectroTech Distributors, LLC - Specializing in retail sales of low-voltage electrical components and accessories.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, due to a supplier's quality defect, we experienced a recall of defective light fixtures, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The product was removed from our inventory, and our supplier took responsibility for the replacement costs. The recall has been fully resolved, and we have implemented additional quality control checks to prevent similar issues in the future. Status: Resolved.
